subject: Potential ISV integration: revenue & referral guardrails
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@oriontools.io>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: Orion Tools connector + rev-share proposal

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking a quick sync last week. As discussed, Orion Tools has a lightweight connector that maps our ingestion pipeline into Redwood's inference endpoints. We see a clear customer motion where we pilot together (proof-of-concept + a 30-day trial) and then offer an out-of-the-box integration on our marketplace.

High level ask: could Redwood consider a 20% referral fee on net MRR for leads we bring that convert within 6 months, and a 10% reseller margin if Orion is reselling Redwood as part of a bundled offering? We want simple, predictable guardrails for registration, anti-duplicate protection, and a 12-month clawback window.

Attaching a short SOW and a technical diagram so your product folks can validate the flow (Orion_Tools_SOW_v1.pdf, technical-connector-diagram.png).

Happy to walk legal/partnerships through a quick MOU. Proposed next step: can you introduce the right person on your side for commission/registration rules and legal?

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships, Orion Tools
[samira.k@oriontools.io]

--- attachment: Orion_Tools_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
--- attachment: technical-connector-diagram.png (image/png)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@oriontools.io>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Orion Tools connector + rev-share proposal

Samira — thanks for the materials and the clear ask. Short reply while I loop in GTM and partner ops:

- We can engage on both referral and reseller motions but we split them operationally. Referral: standard is a timeboxed registration (6 months is common), lead protection window typically 12 months from signup. Resale: needs an approved reseller agreement + SKU map.
- Commission bands: 15–25% referral range depending on deal size and co-sell involvement; reseller margins vary by committed volume and support model.
- Clawbacks: we typically do a 12-month pro-rated clawback for credits/returns/non-payment.

Please see attached a redwood MOU template for partner pilots (redwood-mou-template.docx). Camila — can you review the SOW and advise an initial referral % and whether we can fast-track a reseller SKU? Marissa — legal/finance quick check on clawback and invoicing cadence?

I propose a 30-minute alignment call Friday to lock an initial mutual action plan (MAP). Samira, what times on Friday PST work for you?

Thanks,
Sofia Ivánova
Head of Strategic Alliances, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com
--- attachment: redwood-mou-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com
To: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro: Orion Tools connector + rev-share proposal (internal)

Camila / Marissa — forwarding Orion's SOW and my response. TL;DR asks:

- Camila: propose a starter referral percentage and an onboarding SLA for the connector (docs, tech contact, test account) so we can call out co-sell effort credit. Think: 18% referral, ramp to 22% on >$50k ARR. Also confirm whether the reseller SKU can be a marked-up managed sku or if finance requires a resale agreement.
- Marissa: finance/legal, quick point on clawback handling. Our normal wording is 12-month pro-rated clawback tied to cancellations/credits. For reseller motion we need an invoice flow: Orion invoices their customers; Redwood invoices Orion monthly for consumed tokens or we net; which is preferable from finance ops?

I attached the SOW and diagram. Quick notes below on negotiation posture: do not give exclusivity, require lead registration in HubSpot with clear metadata, require a 30-day notice on trial-to-paid transition for referral credit, and include simple termination for repeated non-payment.

If you agree I will propose the initial numbers to Samira on Friday and send a one-page MAP to sign.

— Sofia
Head of Strategic Alliances
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Intro: Orion Tools connector + rev-share proposal

Thanks, Sofia — Friday PST works for us (11/27 was tight; 11/28 10:00am PST is good). Darren (our product lead) will join to validate the connector API surface.

On the commercial bullets we can accept the initial referral band and the 12-month pro-rated clawback — appreciate the clarity. A couple of asks from our side:

1) Lead registration — can Redwood expose a lead token we can include in our checkout so it's a deterministic claim (rather than relying on manual HubSpot matching)?
2) For reseller flows can we do gross-to-net reconciliation monthly and have a 45-day payment term?

I've attached a redline of your MOU with a couple of minor clarifications and a DocuSign request so legal can get this in motion.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Samira
Head of Partnerships, Orion Tools
